correction.text: Strongest feature: Malpass answers the timing challenge by deriving present completion from ten numbers remaining ten minutes earlier plus a fixed rate, offering a coherent local explanation proportioned to its warrant. Principal limitation: The account postpones the deeper question of why the beginningless countdown has that global alignment, so it cannot explain the infinite history or eliminate the opponent’s residual mystery. Live burden: The reply shows that a particular finishing time can be intelligible without a complete origin story, while still owing an account of whether shifting the explanatory demand backward addresses the paradox. Locked score: The very strong 87 reflects direct contact, stable terms, explicit qualification, and charitable acknowledgment of what remains unexplained, tempered by subsidiary burden and expressly partial reach of the account.
